assumptions.statement: Official exact site and key-area polygons are not present; repository-maintained provisional rough constraints are used without authority upgrade.
assumptions.impact: All geometry, areas, ratios, figures, HTML and PDFs must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, parcels, ownership, buildings, heritage controls, municipal utilities, fire and engineering conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Land use, buildings, mobility, public space and phasing are conceptual references only and cannot support statutory or construction decisions.

assumptions.statement: No operator, investor, enterprise, university, resident body or government department is assumed to have accepted a role.
assumptions.impact: All governance bodies, partnerships, events and service desks are proposed organisation types, not established entities or commitments.

assumptions.statement: Current user, transport, energy, public-space, ecology, talent and enterprise-service baselines are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: The proposal defines formulas and gates before targets; it does not fabricate performance gains or investment returns.

assumptions.statement: Phases and projects describe evidence gates rather than approved construction or funding schedules.
assumptions.impact: Any physical intervention requires official data, professional design, public participation, permissions and confirmed operations before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Green space, public space and building footprints are separate semantic proposal layers and may intentionally overlap.
assumptions.impact: Overlap areas are reported explicitly; green, public-space and building ratios must not be added together or read as mutually exclusive statutory land accounts.
